sentences.text: A review describes Corynebacterium pseudodiphtheriticum as a common, harmless member of the human upper respiratory tract and skin microbiota.
The same review reports that it has been increasingly reported as an etiologic agent of community-acquired and nosocomial infections, and describes it as a human pathobiont.
That review also reports that infections caused by this species are frequently misclassified as contamination and overlooked during clinical and laboratory diagnosis.

An in vitro study describes it, with Dolosigranulum pigrum, as a commensal commonly isolated from the nasopharynx of healthy children, and reports that both significantly reduced pneumococcal growth in co-culture.
A case report describes it as typically a benign inhabitant of the upper respiratory tract that has emerged as a potential opportunistic pathogen in immunocompromised individuals.
